features.name: Repository agent harness
features.description: Provide repository instructions, restartable state, a verification entry point, and a session handoff for future coding-agent work.
done_criteria: CLAUDE.md routes startup, scope, verification, and end-of-session work
feature_list.json and progress.md record current state and evidence
init.sh runs the repository's CI-equivalent unit checks
session-handoff.md gives the next session an exact restart path
The harness validator reports no missing subsystem
features.evidence: Harness validator: 100/100, all five subsystems 5/5. bash -n init.sh: passed. python -m ruff check .: passed. git diff --check: passed. ./init.sh reached pytest but full collection is blocked because the available Python 3.14 environment lacks project dependencies; the checked-in .venv references missing C:\Python313\python.exe.

features.name: TradingAgents skill hardening
features.description: Improve the repository-local TradingAgents skill with lifecycle guidance, compatibility safeguards, executable eval coverage, and static validation.
done_criteria: SKILL.md routes repository startup, one-feature scope, parity/contract checks, and end-of-session evidence
The skill includes a substantive response contract distinguishing facts, assumptions, skipped checks, and blockers
evals/evals.json contains five focused cases with human expectations and machine-checkable assertions
scripts/validate_skill.py validates frontmatter, references, current CLI syntax, lifecycle guidance, and eval structure
Skill and repository static checks pass; environment-blocked tests are recorded explicitly
features.evidence: Five independent behavioral evals passed 20/20 assertions. python skills/tradingagents/scripts/validate_skill.py: passed (5 evals). python -m json.tool skills/tradingagents/evals/evals.json: passed. Skill Creator quick_validate.py: passed. bash -n init.sh: passed. python -m ruff check .: passed. git diff --check: passed. ./init.sh reached pytest but collection is blocked by Python 3.14.5 missing project dependencies including yfinance, langchain_anthropic, typer, and questionary; no live provider or credentialed analysis was run.
